page.layout: One column of running text with a numbered list of comets in the main column; marginal notes in the left margin beside the list ("Apud Plinium, Gellium & Senecam." and "Haec apud Aristotelem non habetur."); the remaining text runs below in the main column.

main_text.l: 1. Cometes generatim proprie dictus is est, qui
circumquaq; hispidus & comas habens apparet.
2. Γωνωνίας, cum inferiori ex parte imaginem
exhibet prolixae barbae. Ab alijs plures species
adduntur.
3. Ἀνούτιας, cum effigiem iaculi repraesentat.
4. Χιφίας, cum brevior & in mucrone desinens
ac pallens exprimit effigiem gladij.
5. Αἰονευς, qui disci habet speciem, & colorem
ostendit electri.
6. Γ.Θὸς, figura dolij ignescens, fumo interspersa.
7. Κεράσυς, cui caesaries est diducta in modum
cornu.
8. Λαμπαδίας, quando instar accensae facis.
9. Ἵππος vel Ἱππεὺς, ubi equinae iubae figura.
Qui fit, quod quidam cometae loco mo-
ventur, quidam vero stabiles
fixiq; manent?
Quemadmodum materia ipsa dispositu est, ut mo-
veatur aut quiescat: ita contingit ipsum quoq; co-
metam moveri aut quiescere. Etenim quae causae sper
stantur motus & quietis in alijs ignitis meteoris,
eadem & hic locum habent.
Deprehensi aut sunt varij cometarum motus,
quorum etiam diversae rationes reddi possunt.
1. Aliquado ab oriente in occidentem more alio-
rum astrorum tendunt. Nimirum vehemens motus cœli

page.notes: Printed page number "506" is read as "506" (the scan shows "506" with a smudged first digit, possibly "806"); Greek letters in items 2–9 transcribed from a worn print and may contain errors; "electri" and "Θὸς" and "Κεράσυς" are doubtful; "sper" in the line "quae causae sper stantur" is a misreading and should read "sistantur" or similar — marked uncertain. Marginal note placement follows the printed positions in the left margin. Catchword "cœli" appears at the lower right and is left out of the text above per the rules; it is a faint printed word at the foot of the last line.
